trend: 'I'm fine on 6 hours' (classic sleep restriction trial)
why: Pure education with no product, and a classic, well-cited finding that our desk-worker audience needs to hear.
text:
In a classic trial, adults kept to 6 hours of sleep a night for two weeks slid to attention scores close to a night without sleep.

The catch: they rated themselves only a little sleepy. Feeling fine on 6 hours and performing fine on 6 hours are different things.
